CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible.
   D. Say The Bible has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Use Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Christ.
   D. Say Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Creation of Plants and Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Creation of Plants and Animals.
   B. Use Creation of Plants and Animals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Creation of Plants and Animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Creation of Plants and Animals has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of My 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My 1.0 Creation.
   B. Use My 1.0 Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say My 1.0 Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of My 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ.
   C. Use Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

8. Which response best shows understanding of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation.
   B. Apply the teaching of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story: Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bible Story: Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story: Holy Bible.
   C. Say Bible Story: Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Bible Story: Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible Story;? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Bible Story; has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Bible Story; to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible Story;.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Sharing values? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sharing values.
   B. Use Sharing values to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Sharing values has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Sharing values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Physical? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Physical with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Physical has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Physical to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Physical.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Physical and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Bible Story: Holy Bible and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Bible and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Bible Story; and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

6. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust
